mapper.select: SELECT id, token_hash, token_family_id, subject_type, subject_id, device_id, expires_at, revoked_at, replaced_by_token_hash, created_at FROM refresh_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refresh_token (token_hash, token_family_id, subject_type, subject_id, device_id, expires_at, revoked_at, replaced_by_token_hash, created_at) VALUES (#{tokenHash}, #{tokenFamilyId}, #{subjectType}, #{subjectId}, #{deviceId}, #{expiresAt}, #{revokedAt}, #{replacedByTokenHash}, #{createdAt})
